ID: `jado-visual-designer`.

## What it does

Builds the assigned canvas at the stage's fidelity: in explore many divergent low-fidelity options built fast, in refine the selected direction with tokens and states, in ship production fidelity. Sole document author during the phase; respects the fix-pass cap and hands the result to the reviewer only when the stage requires one.

## When to use it

Use it to define or produce the composition of a surface, or to compare authorized alternatives in the canvas. A reference still awaiting selection must be clarified before being presented as an approved direction.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/jado-visual-designer` in Claude Code or `$jado-visual-designer` in Codex. Provide the brief, direction or comparison question, content, assigned artboards and stage. Specify what may change and which result must be preserved.

## What it delivers

- Assigned canvas composition and nodes
- Final captures and structural verification
- Handoff to the reviewer or code phase

## Example

Prepare the mobile project detail artboard in Paper following the selected direction. Preserve content and tokens and verify cropping and text before delivery.

## Prerequisites

- Working in Paper requires document access and an assignment authorizing canvas edits.
